codeReview.summary: Clean and thorough implementation of the editor feature flag gating. All editor-specific fields, modules, frame logic, input handling, and rendering are correctly gated behind #[cfg(feature = "editor")]. The no-editor codepath renders fullscreen viewport with no panels. Both editor-ON and editor-OFF modes compile and pass all 209 workspace tests. Clippy is clean in both modes.

issues.description: No new tests were added for the no-editor codepath. While the feature is primarily a cfg-gating refactor (no new logic), a compilation test verifying cargo check --no-default-features would have been beneficial as a regression guard. The handoff verification already covers this manually.

Three modules (UIRenderer, Theme, BackgroundLoader) use #![cfg_attr(not(feature = "editor"), allow(dead_code))] to suppress warnings in no-editor mode. These modules are compiled but unused when editor is off. This is a pragmatic trade-off since gating them fully would require more extensive refactoring, but it means the no-editor binary carries dead code for these types.

The 'editor' feature flag in katla_app/Cargo.toml is a bare flag with no dependencies (editor = []). If the editor feature grows to depend on specific crate features from katla_ui or other dependencies, this should be extended. Currently correct for the gating use case.

sharedStateObservations.observation: architecture.md was not updated to document the new 'editor' feature flag in katla_app. The architecture doc should mention: (1) katla_app has an optional 'editor' feature (default on), (2) when off, editor_ui, gui_state, gizmo, background_loader, and UIRenderer are excluded from compilation or dead-code-allowed, (3) the no-editor codepath renders fullscreen viewport with no panels. This would help future workers understand the cfg gating without reading the full diff.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The check-app-no-default command already exists in services.yaml ('cargo check -p katla_app --no-default-features'), which is exactly the verification needed for this feature. Good alignment.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The app-worker SKILL.md does not mention Cargo feature flags or cfg gating patterns. Since this is a new pattern for the crate, it may be worth adding a note about the 'editor' feature flag to help future workers understand when to gate code.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The katla_app/AGENTS.md frame order section still references 'poll_background_loader()' as step 3 and 'generate_ui_draw_list()' as step 5 without noting these are editor-only steps. When editor is off, the frame order is simplified to: world.update, particle_system.update, render_frame(None). This could confuse future workers.

summary: The app-editor-decoupling feature is well-implemented. All editor-specific code (EditorUI, GuiState, gizmo, background loader, entity instance maps, stencil indicator, thumbnail textures, editor frame logic, editor input handling) is correctly gated behind #[cfg(feature = "editor")] across 10 files. The no-editor codepath compiles cleanly and provides a fullscreen viewport. All 209 tests pass, clippy is clean in both modes. Minor observations: no tests for the no-editor path, three modules use allow(dead_code) suppression, and architecture.md/katla_app AGENTS.md were not updated to document the new feature flag.
